headline: Expanse Holds Heavy Wire as Row Quickens
war_summary: Since the 21:19 edition the Weathered Expanse holds the heavy wire with 57 changes on the day and six in the last two hours to 23:40 about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, holdings now listed at three Warden and six Colonial with day losses of 6,953 Colonial and 10,582 Warden. Fisherman's Row has quickened further to 12 changes in two hours and 27 on the day to 23:55 about Black Well, Eidolo and Dankana Post, holdings now two Warden and seven Colonial. Callahan's Passage adds three changes in two hours and 25 on the day to 23:30 about The Crumbling Passage and Scath Passing, holdings eight Warden and two Colonial. Stlican Shelf stirs anew with six changes in two hours to 23:30 about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, holdings four Warden and five Colonial. Mooring County shows three changes in two hours to 22:55 about Wiccwalk and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, holdings twelve Warden. Stema Landing reports two changes in two hours to the 00:11 cutoff about The Flair and The Wane, while Palantine Berm and Nevish Line have gone quiet with last reports at 18:11 and 19:29.
